name: Concepts in 3-Dimension Cell Culture
description: Introduction and historical perspective of 3D cell culture; need for studying biology in 3-dimensions; fundamentals and types of 3D cultures (organoids, spheroids, assembloids etc.); static versus dynamic cultures; requirements and methods for 3D cultures; applications of 3D cultures (organ systems, precision medicine, clinical trials); limitations and parameters for optimization of current 3D culture technologies; ethics and future implications for 3D cultures (bioprinting, organ-on-chip, microphysiological systems); visual guide to 3D cell culture techniques.
